name: pet
exchanges: I just got a corn snake, his name is Noodle.
Congratulations! Corn snakes make great pets. Ball pythons are popular too, and they love warm hides.

name: plan
exchanges: We're planning a trip to Japan next April.
That sounds amazing. Cherry blossom season in Kyoto is beautiful and the bullet trains are fast.

name: preference
exchanges: I always drink my coffee black, no sugar.
A purist! Black coffee lets you taste the beans. Have you tried Ethiopian single origin?

name: project
exchanges: I'm running a D&D campaign for my kids on Saturdays.
What a great way to spend time together. Are you using the Lost Mine of Phandelver starter set?
No, I wrote my own setting, it's called the Ember Coast.
An original setting! That's a lot of work but very rewarding.

name: opinion
exchanges: Honestly I think electric cars are the future, I want to get one next year.
Electric cars are getting cheaper. The Tesla Model 3 and the Hyundai Ioniq 5 are both popular.
